name: draft_documents
description: Draft, as PDFs, a complaint letter to the bank, an incident description for the cybercrime portal (NCRP) and a complaint to the RBI Ombudsman, using the same case facts as compute_entitlement. Every amount, paragraph and date is filled in by the rules engine. Returns one-hour download links and the blanks the user must fill in. Drafts only: the user reviews, signs and files them.

entity.description: Bank type: CB (commercial), SFB, PB (payments bank), LAB, RRB, UCB or RCB. Default CB

account_type.description: BSBD, SB, PPI_GIFT, MSME_CA_CC_OD, INDIV_CA_CC_OD_UPTO_25L, CC_UPTO_5L, OTHER_CA_CC_OD or CC_ABOVE_5L. Default SB

individual.description: True for an individual or sole proprietor

answers.description: Interview facts. Set only what the user confirmed; omit unknowns.

missing_sms_alert_over_500.description: A debit above Rs 500 came with no SMS alert from the bank

bank_ignored_notification.description: The bank did not act on the customer's fraud report

bank_system_breach.description: Bank system breach or internal fraud

sim_swap_or_telecom_fault.description: SIM swap or telecom operator failure

tpap_pa_pg_breach.description: Failure of a UPI app, payment aggregator or payment gateway

shared_credentials.description: The customer shared an OTP, PIN, password or card details with someone

ignored_specific_bank_warning.description: The customer ignored a specific warning from the bank

installed_malicious_app.description: The customer installed a screen-sharing or remote-access app at someone's request

coerced_approval.description: The customer approved payments under threat or duress, e.g. a 'digital arrest' call

pure_deception_no_credentials_no_coercio.description: The customer was tricked into paying with no credentials shared and no threat

alert_received_date.description: Date the bank's SMS or email alert arrived, ISO date; omit if none

cross_border.description: True if the payment went abroad

utr.description: UTR or reference number of the debit, letters and digits only

mode.description: UPI, card, net banking, IMPS or similar

beneficiary.description: Who received the money as shown in the bank message, e.g. a UPI ID or masked account

bank_reported_at.description: When the fraud was reported to the bank, ISO date-time (from the bank's acknowledgement if possible)

ncrp_reported_at.description: When it was reported on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, ISO date-time

recoveries_credited.description: Money already credited back to the customer, in rupees (not merely frozen)

lifetime_compensation_used.description: True if the customer already received 76T compensation once

documents.description: Which drafts to make. Default all three

complainant_name.description: The account holder's name as the user gave it. Omit to leave a blank

account_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the account or card only, never the full number

bank_complaint_ref.description: Complaint number the bank gave, if any

ncrp_ack.description: NCRP or 1930 acknowledgement number, if any

incident_summary.description: What happened, in English, in the user's own words as confirmed by them (at most 1500 characters). No OTPs, PINs or full numbers

bank_reply.description: The bank's reply so far. Default none

bank_reply_date.description: Date of the bank's reply, ISO date

as_of.description: Date to print on the letters, ISO date. Leave empty for today
